name: Toudou Honoka
source:
She is cool and a perfectionist, and has no interest in anything other than chemistry. She has a distant attitude towards her students.

She secretly conducts research to help her sister, who is suffering from an incurable disease.

[Translated from [url=https://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HB/onnakyoushi/index.html]Official Site[/url]]
